arguments.sql:
WITH category_items AS (
    SELECT i.order_id, p.product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS item_count
    FROM main.olist_order_items AS i
    JOIN main.olist_products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY i.order_id, p.product_category_name
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_order_category_rows,
       SUM(c.item_count) AS paid_item_rows,
       SUM(c.product_category_name IS NULL) AS missing_category_rows,
       SUM(c.product_category_name = '') AS empty_category_rows,
       SUM(p.payment_type IS NULL) AS missing_method_rows
FROM category_items AS c
JOIN main.olist_order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = c.order_id

arguments.sql:
WITH order_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id, p.product_category_name
    FROM main.olist_order_items AS i
    JOIN main.olist_products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
),
method_counts AS (
    SELECT c.product_category_name, pay.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
    FROM order_categories AS c
    JOIN main.olist_order_payments AS pay ON pay.order_id = c.order_id
    GROUP BY c.product_category_name, pay.payment_type
),
category_maxima AS (
    SELECT product_category_name, MAX(payment_count) AS preferred_method_payments
    FROM method_counts
    GROUP BY product_category_name
)
SELECT AVG(preferred_method_payments) AS avg_preferred_method_payments
FROM category_maxima
LIMIT 1
